cards.back: Groups with the same number in each. 3 bags of 2 apples are equal groups.
cards.say: Equal groups. Groups with the same number in each. Three bags of two apples are equal groups.

cards.back: To find the total of equal groups by repeated adding. 3 groups of 2 is 3 × 2 = 6.
cards.say: Multiply. To find the total of equal groups by repeated adding. Three groups of two is three times two equals six.

cards.back: Four times two. It means 4 groups of 2.
cards.say: How do you read four times two? Four times two. It means four groups of two.
